title: Single hieratic sign, London, British Museum, EA 10102 (AKU HT 12517)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Svenja A. Gülden, Tabitha Kraus; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 12517

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 12517; AKU grapheme K0010 (AKU GR 329). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: K1 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 253. Occurrence: line 9; find place Theben; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 9.2 x 11.3 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 18. Dynastie, Thutmosis III.". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Svenja A. Gülden, Tabitha Kraus. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
